title: PLAYER 2 BLASTS GO PAST THE SHIELD
why: v26.72 says a SHIELDED elite soaks your rounds first and a blast, a mine or fire goes straight past it. On the host only the round path soaks (affixSoak is called only there); the host frag, fists, finisher and air strike take the full damage. But the host applied the shield to every shot word player 2 sends, so his frag, fists, finisher and air strike were eaten by the shield. Proven in the fixture: the host air strike on a shielded elite took 213 hit points and left the shield at 200; the same strike from player 2 took 13 and emptied the shield. Now player 2s gun round carries a mark and the host soaks only that word with the shield, so his frag, fists, finisher and air strike go past it as the hosts do.
now: Player 2s grenades, melee and air strike now go straight past a shielded elites shield, the same as player 1s.
